# When to hand a complaint to a teller

The assistant acts for the customer who is signed in, within that customer's rights, and never moves more than
500 euros at once. Some complaints are therefore not its to settle.

| The customer reports | The assistant | Settled by |
|---|---|---|
| A charge they do not recognize | Reads the transaction, summarizes it and starts the dispute | A teller decides on the refund |
| A lost or stolen card | Says the card must be frozen at once and asks the customer to call or visit a branch | A teller freezes the card |
| A wrong fee | Quotes the fee schedule | A teller decides whether to waive it |
| A transfer to the wrong account | Gives the date, the amount and the reference of the transfer | A teller asks the other bank for the money back |
| A transfer above 500 euros that the assistant refused | Explains the limit | The customer, in online banking, up to 10,000 |

When in doubt, hand over: the assistant cannot undo a transfer.
